name: HuggingChat (huggingface.co/chat)

capabilities.name: Chat stream
capabilities.description: Create conversation (POST /chat/conversation) + send prompt on the composer; NDJSON answer stream off POST /chat/conversation/{id} (Chunked ReadableStream, newline-delimited JSON events), resume via EventSource /chat/conversation/{id}/stream, stop via /stop-generating
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler); full wire pinned in bundles

capabilities.name: Model catalog & picker
capabilities.description: GET /chat/api/v2/models (140 + omni router, live payload) and /models/{id}; activeModel + system prompt + tools/reasoning/artifacts overrides via /chat/settings and the conversation-create body

capabilities.name: Settings read/upsert
capabilities.description: GET /chat/api/v2/user/settings and debounced POST /chat/settings (streamingMode smooth|raw, customPrompts, toolsOverrides, artifactsOverrides, providerOverrides, reasoningOverrides)

capabilities.name: MCP servers
capabilities.description: GET /chat/api/mcp/servers (base Web Search (Exa) + Hugging Face); enabled servers attached to each send (selectedMcpServerNames/selectedMcpServers)
capabilities.method: v2 REST over same-origin cookies + per-turn body field

transport.chatSend: POST https://huggingface.co/chat/conversation/{id} (multipart/form-data; data=<JSON>) -> 200 Chunked NDJSON event stream (verified in chunks/D_6jIJz0.js)
transport.settingsUpsert: POST https://huggingface.co/chat/settings (full settings JSON, 300ms debounce) (verified in chunks/CZhNzXSe.js)
transport.management: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE https://huggingface.co/chat/api/v2/{conversations,conversations/{id},conversations/{id}/message/{messageId},conversations/import-share,models,models/{id},models/old,user,user/settings,user/reports,user/billing-orgs,feature-flags,public-config,debug/config,export,spaces/deploy}, GET /chat/api/mcp/servers (verified in chunks/DVITWop-.js + SSR data-sveltekit-fetched payloads)

auth.kind: session-snapshot (same-origin cookies; no API token in client at all)
auth.note: Anonymous works (GET /chat/api/v2/user = null; 140 models + full chat flow reachable signed-out). Exact cookie set (hf-chat family) is server-set and NOT visible in client bundles - unverified statically; capture once with `ui2api profile capture "https://huggingface.co/chat" --login` and record snapshot hash in session.lock.json. 401 with /oauth authorization|has been revoked|requested scopes/ -> redirect /login?next=<path>

analysisMethod: static curl + SvelteKit bundle reading (~0.8MB: app dictionary, DVITWop-/D7aK-xnk/D_6jIJz0 chunks, nodes 4/5/11/12 + SSR data-sveltekit-fetched payloads); no browser launched
